title: SOMA Auth: LinkedIn redirect URL
_note: App 264207680. Redirect editor: pencil button (aria-label contains edit), then Add redirect URL, input aria-label 'redirect URL', then Update. Client ID is public (#clientIdInput); the secret is never read.

steps.instruction: Yeshie added the redirect URL https://omfwcodoimjmbrhssvfl.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback (SOMA Auth's Supabase callback). Check it, then click Update.
Click Copy next to Primary Client Secret, so the secret is on your clipboard for the Supabase step. Leave this tab open.
